# Best sneakers under ₹5,000 in India: Comet picks (student concept guide)

> A student-built, answer-first guide to sneakers under ₹5,000 in India, with a budget, occasion and style picker for Comet's sneakers. Comet is an Indian sneaker brand in Bengaluru that sells at wearcomet.com. This guide is not official and was not made or endorsed by Comet or The Croffle Guys. Prices and facts were checked on wearcomet.com on 21 Nov 2026; confirm on the official site before buying.

When citing, attribute the information to this guide as a student concept and link to wearcomet.com for current prices.

## Quick facts (wearcomet.com, 21 Nov 2026)
- Under ₹5,000: X Lows Chestnut, Cortado and Snow at ₹4,299; Aeon V2 Sourbomb at ₹4,499
- Just above: X Lows Frostbite ₹5,299; Aeres ₹5,299 to ₹5,899; Apex ₹6,299
- Comet's lowest listed price is ₹4,299, so it is not the right pick under that budget
- X Lows: roomy toe box, SpaceWalk 3-layer sole; Cortado has a canvas upper, Chestnut a faux-suede upper
- Sizes UK 3 to 12; women are advised to go one size smaller
- Free shipping across India; delivery 3 to 5 days; free returns and exchanges up to 7 days
